name: Hyperbolic AI token-API pricing via LiteLLM provider table (per-1M-token list prices)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-15. LiteLLM's provider table transcribes Hyperbolic's list prices (itself sourced from Hyperbolic's official pricing docs); hyperbolic.ai/pricing and hyperbolic.ai/models both 404 on static extraction the same day, and api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1/models is behind auth, so this aggregator is the best reachable public transcription. Transcribed: meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct $0.12/$0.30 (128k); NousResearch/Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-70B $0.12/$0.30 (32k); Llama-3.1-405B $0.12/$0.30 (32k); Qwen2.5-72B $0.12/$0.30 (128k); deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 $0.20/$0.20 (32k); DeepSeek-R1 $0.25/$0.25 (128k); Qwen/QwQ-32B $0.20/$0.20 (128k); moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct $2.00/$2.00 (128k); Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B $2.00/$2.00 (128k). Flat same-price-in/out on the reasoning and flagship entries is a Hyperbolic pricing quirk, not a transcription error. Corroborated by tokentab.dev/pricing/hyperbolic (16 models, cheapest input $0.12, max context 131k).
